breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the ideal-gas law is inappropriate for a liquid. It explicitly instructed to treat water as an incompressible fluid with its known density (rho = 998 kg/m³) and added a direct negative constraint: "Do not apply the ideal-gas law at any point in the calculation." This perfectly aligns with the ground truth's correction.
